column1: # Deliberate differences between sources/yomitan.json and Yomitan's Old Irish rules at d3c54c1 (docs/languages.md 8.2), checked by tools/check-yomitan.mjs.

column7: Yomitan's tryAlternateOrthography rules with notBeginning replace (?<!^)XY with the g flag; on a text that starts with three of the doubled letter (oook) the first match fails the lookbehind and the regular expression matches again one letter on (oook -> oók). The pack's replace rule with notAtStart skips the match at the start and continues after it, so it finds none in oook (src/languages/transforms.cpp). sources/map-yomitan.mjs compares both on 102,303 probe texts and finds no other difference. No Old Irish word starts with a tripled letter.
